text_block_list.text:
One holiday, I spotted Air Groove
hanging out with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~~~ Smells goooood...! 
And there's so many colors, it's so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Is this the flower shop
you wanted to visit, Air Groove?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, I have a little business to take care of.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
They have so many gardening supplies here.
Pots, soil, and over there is... fertilizer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the fertilizer is over there.
The display has changed since the last time I came.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Before... do you come here often?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Right.
Gardening was your hobby, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm honored you remembered me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's really amazing being able to grow flowers... I'm sure I'd end up withering them halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't say it's without its hardships,
but it's something I do for my own satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is essentially no different from how you, who love to run,
carefully maintain your horseshoes every single day.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that's really the case...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Since we have the chance,
why don't you get to know the flowers a little too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't tell you to plant it, but how about
starting off by giving one as a gift?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Give a gift? ...Flowers, to someone?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is a time-honored way to convey one's feelings.
Isn't it an approachable method even for someone of few words like yourself?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The beauty of flowers is proof of their life. And in their full bloom, people have always found meaning and heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let's try picking one.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Gerberas... Wow, there are so many colors.
They feel so bright and full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Gerberas symbolize 'always moving forward' and 'hope'.
Their charming appearance makes them popular for gifts.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't that be just right for that girl who's been following you around lately?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Spe-chan... You're right.
The vibe might actually suit her well...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I think they'd be utterly shocked before they could even feel happy, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey heeey!! What about me?!
Pick one out for me too, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If Air Groove were to give me a gift,
which one would you choose!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I were to give a gift to Taiki, you say? Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then 'Oncidium' is the only choice.
A brilliant, dazzling yellow, such a vibrant presence—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the meaning is
"Shall we dance?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so good!!
Let's dance, Air Groove!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Should I go with flowers that mean 'know your place'?

"Smiling warmly at the sight of them enjoying their day off,
I left the scene so as not to disturb them."
And then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Do you read books?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Answer my question. ...Do you read books?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, that's a vague answer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Even I realize that you study diligently and put careful thought into your daily plans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Keep working hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That is all. Let's begin the meeting.

Inside the bag I received
was a bookmark made of pressed bluestar flowers.
Blue star... 'Trusting Hearts'—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"How can you call yourself a Trainer like that...?
There's a mountain of textbooks and reference materials you should be reading."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I wish they'd show a little more self-awareness.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You are the one chosen by none other than myself, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Look at this and reflect on yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That is all. Let's begin the meeting.

Inside the bag I received
was a bookmark made of pressed gloriosa flowers.
Gloriosa, meaning "Glory"—
